title: EEG field-kit calibration file (EEG-CAL-1)
description: The file firmware/tools/provision.py writes into the unit at TST-EEG-004 T6. GENERATED by firmware/tools/calibration_schema.py -- edit that file and run it again, do not edit this one. PROPOSAL: the key names and nesting are the programme's decision (FW-EEG-001 section 10 assigns the calibration-record schema to CAL-EEG-012); every key and every bound here is one quantity a numbered test says it records. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0.

unit_serial.description: PKG-EEG-015 section 5. provision.py refuses a file whose unit_serial is not the serial it was given.

measured_utc.description: when the constants were measured, ISO-8601 UTC

example_only.description: true in the shipped example. provision.py refuses to write a file with example_only true, so a template cannot reach a unit.

protection_series_resistor_ohm.description: ohm. Source: DSN-EEG-003 R1-R16 / ECO-EEG-024. The series protection resistor actually fitted: 47000 on the Phase 1 prototypes, 68000 if ECO-EEG-024 is taken. T10's R_off acceptance is +/- 5 % of this value, so a file without it cannot be interpreted.

r_off_ohm.description: ohm. Source: TST-EEG-004 T10. Fitted offset. T10's limit is 'within the fitted series-resistor value +/- 5 %', which is 47 kOhm today and 68 kOhm if ECO-EEG-024 is taken, so the bound is relative to protection_series_resistor_ohm and is checked there.

k.description: slope of the least-squares fit. Source: TST-EEG-004 T10. OPEN: T10 states neither the unit nor the range of k. Until the programme states whether the raw lead-off reading is in ADC counts or in ohms, two shops can produce two incomparable numbers here. README_provisioning.md section 4 item 1.

scaling_mv_at_converter.description: mV at the ADS1299 input for a 1.1 V peak envelope. Source: TST-EEG-004 T12a. T12a's limit is 'within +/- 5 % of 100 mV at the converter input'.

group_delay_median_samples.description: samples at 1000 Hz. Source: TST-EEG-004 T12b. The absolute offset is recorded as a constant and is not judged; the calculated expectation is 4.40 samples (1 / (Q x 2 pi x f0), Q = 0.7416, f0 = 48.77 Hz).

group_delay_iqr_samples.description: samples at 1000 Hz. Source: TST-EEG-004 T12b. T12b's limit is on the spread: '<= 2 samples'.

lowpass_f0_hz.description: Hz. Source: TST-EEG-004 T12e. T12e's band. It is wider than RFQ E-11's 50 Hz +/- 10 %, which no build with the fitted X7R capacitors can hold; TST-EEG-004 Note 1 carries that conflict.

comparator_threshold_mv.description: mV. Source: TST-EEG-004 T12c. One TLV3201 at U7, so one value. Calculated expectation 52 mV (2.5 V x 10 k / 480 k) with about 5 mV of hysteresis from R82.

ac_coupling_corner_hz.description: Hz. Source: TST-EEG-004 T12d. T12d's limit is '<= 2 Hz'; the calculated expectation is 1.6 Hz. T12d's record row states one corner and not one per channel, so this is a file-level value; T12e's f0 is explicitly per channel and is nested per channel.

mic_mute_attenuation_db.description: dB. Source: TST-EEG-004 T17. T17's limit is '>= 60 dB'.

level_dbu_into_47r.description: dBu into 47.0 ohm. Source: TST-EEG-004 T17. T17's limit is 'within 1 dB of target'; the target is per headphone model and is not stated numerically in TST-EEG-004, so no bound is imposed here.

thd_percent.description: %. Source: TST-EEG-004 T17. T17's limit is 'THD <= 0.1 %'.

level_register.description: codec register value. Source: TST-EEG-004 T17. OPEN: no document in this package states the width of the codec volume register, so no upper bound can be imposed. README_provisioning.md section 4 item 2.

clamp_register.description: codec register value. Source: TST-EEG-004 T28. The lot clamp. RFQ E-29 requires the firmware to clamp the codec volume register at this value; T17 reads it back and 'a clamp value that does not match the lot value is a hard fail and is never adjusted on the line'. Same missing register width as level_register.

spl_db_at_max_commanded.description: dB SPL on an IEC 60318-1 artificial ear. Source: TST-EEG-004 T28. T28's limit is '<= 100 dB SPL at any commanded level'.

spl_db_at_full_scale.description: dB SPL on an IEC 60318-1 artificial ear. Source: TST-EEG-004 T28. The deliberate full-scale write that bypasses the runner's limit. It is expected to exceed 100 dB SPL -- the calculated figure is about 110 -- which is why the clamp exists, so no bound is imposed on it.

headphone_impedance_ohm.description: ohm. Source: TST-EEG-004 T28. RFQ A-04 as restated by T17: 32 to 64 ohm. The shipped ATH-M20x is 47 ohm, which is why the T17 load is 47.0 ohm.

_note.description: optional free prose. The shipped example uses it to say, in the file itself, that the file carries no measurements.

instruments.description: optional. JIG-EEG-009 section 5.2 requires the asset numbers of the instruments used to appear in each unit's record; carry them here if the station has them.
